name: @oresoftware/ores-gh-bots
description: GitHub automation bots for the ORESoftware fleet: nightly cross-org PR reconciliation, dependency-graph-driven PR updates, and readiness-gated auto-merge.

comments.devDependencies: Optional. Runtime and tests use only Node built-ins so the nightly job needs no install step; devDependencies exist purely for local `npm run typecheck`.
